summary: Example NETCONF task creates VLAN 50 named WEB with community.network.ce_vlan.
questions: How do I create a VLAN on a CloudEngine switch?

answer_card.title: Create a VLAN on CloudEngine
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: Create a vlan, id is 50(ce)
  community.network.ce_vlan:
    vlan_id: 50
    name: WEB
  when: ansible_network_os == 'community.network.ce'
```
(`ce_vlan` uses the NETCONF connection.)
